Kaaf Haa Yaa Ain Saad
Yeh Zakariya ke saath tumhaare Parwardigar ki meharbaani ka zikr hai
Jab unhon ne apne Parwardigar ko dheemi aawaaz se pukaara
Kaha ke Parwardigar! Meri haddiyaan kamzor ho gayi hain aur mera sar budhaape ki aag se bhadak utha hai, aur main tujhe pukaarne se kabhi mahroom nahin raha hoon
Aur mujhe apne baad apne khaandaan waalon se khatra hai, aur meri biwi baanjh hai, to ab mujhe ek aisa wali aur waaris ata farma de
Jo mera aur Aal-e-Ya'qoob ka waaris ho, aur Parwardigar! Use apna pasandeeda bhi qaraar de de
Zakariya! Hum tum ko ek farzand ki bashaarat dete hain jis ka naam Yahya hai, aur hum ne is se pehle un ka hum-naam koi nahin banaaya hai
Zakariya ne arz ki: Parwardigar! Mere farzand kis tarah hoga jab ke meri biwi baanjh hai aur main bhi budhaape ki aakhri hadd ko pahunch gaya hoon
Irshaad hua isi tarah tumhaare Parwardigar ka farmaan hai ke yeh baat mere liye bahut aasaan hai, aur main ne is se pehle khud tumhein bhi paida kiya hai jab ke tum kuch nahin the
Unhon ne kaha ke Parwardigar! Is wilaadat ki koi alaamat qaraar de de. Irshaad hua ke tumhaari nishaani yeh hai ke tum teen dinon tak baraabar logon se kalaam nahin karoge
Us ke baad Zakariya mehraab-e-ibaadat se qaum ki taraf nikle aur inhein ishaara kiya ke subah o shaam apne Parwardigar ki tasbeeh karte raho
Yahya! Kitaab ko mazbooti se pakad lo. Aur hum ne inhein bachpane hi mein nubuwwat ata kar di
Aur apni taraf se meharbaani aur paakeezgi bhi ata kar di, aur woh khauf-e-Khuda rakhne waale the
Aur apne maa baap ke haq mein nek bartaao karne waale the, aur sarkash aur naafarmaan nahin the
Un par hamaara salaam jis din paida hue aur jis din inhein maut aayi aur jis din woh dobaara zinda uthaaye jaayenge
Aur Paighambar! Apni kitaab mein Maryam ka zikr karo ke jab woh apne ghar waalon se alag mashriqi simt ki taraf chali gayin
Aur logon ki taraf parda daal diya, to hum ne apni rooh ko bheja jo un ke saamne ek achchha khaasa aadmi ban kar pesh hua
Unhon ne kaha ke agar tu khauf-e-Khuda rakhta hai to main tujh se Khuda ki panaah maangti hoon
Us ne kaha ke main aap ke Rab ka firistaada hoon ke aap ko ek paakeeza farzand ata kar doon
Unhon ne kaha ke mere yahaan farzand kis tarah hoga jab ke mujhe kisi bashar ne chhua bhi nahin hai aur main koi badkirdaar nahin hoon

Us ne kaha ke isi tarah aap ke Parwardigar ka irshaad hai ke mere liye yeh kaam aasaan hai, aur is liye ke main use logon ke liye nishaani bana doon aur apni taraf se rehmat qaraar de doon, aur yeh baat tai-shuda hai
Phir woh haamila ho gayin aur logon se door ek jagah chali gayin
Phir waz'-e-haml ka waqt inhein ek khajoor ki shaakh ke qareeb le aaya to unhon ne kaha ke aye kaash main is se pehle hi mar gayi hoti aur bilkul faraamosh kar dene ke qaabil ho gayi hoti
To us ne neeche se aawaaz di ke aap pareshaan na hon, Khuda ne aap ke qadmon mein chashma jaari kar diya hai
Aur khurme ki shaakh ko apni taraf hilaayein, us se taaza taaza khurme gir padenge

Phir use khaaiye aur peejiye aur apni aankhon ko thandi rakhiye. Phir us ke baad kisi insaan ko dekhiye to keh dijiye ke main ne Rehmaan ke liye roze ki nazr kar li hai, lihaaza aaj main kisi insaan se baat nahin kar sakti
Us ke baad Maryam bachche ko uthaaye hue qaum ke paas aayin to logon ne kaha ke Maryam! Yeh tum ne bahut bura kaam kiya hai
Haaroon ki behan! Na tumhaara baap bura aadmi tha aur na tumhaari maa badkirdaar thi
Unhon ne us bachche ki taraf ishaara kar diya, to qaum ne kaha ke hum us se kaise baat karein jo gehwaare mein bachcha hai
Bachche ne aawaaz di ke main Allah ka banda hoon, us ne mujhe kitaab di hai aur mujhe nabi banaaya hai
Aur jahaan bhi rahoon ba-barakat qaraar diya hai, aur jab tak zinda rahoon namaaz aur zakaat ki wasiyyat ki hai
Aur apni waalida ke saath husn-e-sulook karne waala banaaya hai, aur zaalim o badnaseeb nahin banaaya hai
Aur salaam hai mujh par us din jis din main paida hua aur jis din maroonga aur jis din dobaara zinda uthaaya jaaoonga
Yeh hai Eesa bin Maryam ke baare mein qaul-e-haq jis mein yeh log shak kar rahe the
Allah ke liye munaasib nahin hai ke woh kisi ko apna farzand banaaye, woh paak o be-niyaaz hai. Jab kisi baat ka faisla kar leta hai to us se kehta hai ke ho ja aur woh cheez ho jaati hai
Aur Allah mera aur tumhaara dono ka Parwardigar hai, lihaaza us ki ibaadat karo aur yahi Siraat-e-Mustaqeem hai
Phir mukhtalif girohon ne aapas mein ikhtilaaf kiya, aur wail un logon ke liye hai jinhon ne kufr ikhtiyaar kiya, aur inhein bade sakht din ka saamna karna hoga
Us din jab hamaare paas aayenge to khoob sunenge aur dekhenge, lekin yeh zaalim aaj khuli hui gumraahi mein mubtala hain
Aur un logon ko us hasrat ke din se daraaiye jab qat'i faisla ho jaaega, agarche yeh log ghaflat ke aalam mein pade hue hain aur imaan nahin la rahe hain
Beshak hum zameen aur jo kuch zameen par hai sab ke waaris hain, aur sab hamaari hi taraf palta kar laaye jaayenge
Aur Kitaab-e-Khuda mein Ibraheem alaihis-salaam ka tazkira karo ke woh ek siddeeq paighambar the
Jab unhon ne apne paalne waale baap se kaha ke aap aise ki ibaadat kyon karte hain jo na kuch sunta hai na dekhta hai aur na kisi kaam aane waala hai
Mere paas woh ilm aa chuka hai jo aap ke paas nahin aaya hai, lihaaza aap mera ittibaa' karein, main aap ko seedhe raaste ki hidaayat kar doonga
Baaba! Shaitaan ki ibaadat na kijiye ke Shaitaan Rehmaan ki naafarmaani karne waala hai
Baaba! Mujhe yeh khauf hai ke aap ko Rehmaan ki taraf se koi azaab apni giraft mein le le aur aap Shaitaan ke dost qaraar pa jaayein

Us ne jawaab diya ke Ibraheem! Kya tum mere khudaaon se kinaara-kashi karne waale ho? To yaad rakho ke agar tum is ravish se baaz na aaye to main tumhein sangsaar kar doonga, aur tum hamesha ke liye mujh se door ho jaao
Ibraheem alaihis-salaam ne kaha ke Khuda aap ko salaamat rakhe, main anqareeb apne Rab se aap ke liye maghfirat talab karoonga ke woh mere haal par bahut meharbaan hai
Aur aap ko aap ke ma'boodon samet chhod kar alag ho jaaoonga, aur apne Rab ko aawaaz doonga, ke is tarah main apne Parwardigar ki ibaadat se mahroom na rahoonga
Phir jab Ibraheem alaihis-salaam ne unhein aur un ke ma'boodon ko chhod diya to hum ne inhein Is'haaq alaihis-salaam o Ya'qoob alaihis-salaam jaisi aulaad ata ki aur sab ko nabi qaraar de diya
Aur phir inhein apni rehmat ka ek hissa bhi ata kiya, aur un ke liye sadaaqat ki buland-tareen zabaan bhi qaraar de di
Aur apni kitaab mein Moosa alaihis-salaam ka bhi tazkira karo ke woh mere mukhlis bande aur rasool o nabi the
Aur hum ne inhein Koh-e-Toor ke daahine taraf se aawaaz di aur raaz o niyaaz ke liye apne se qareeb bula liya
Aur phir inhein apni rehmat-e-khaas se un ke bhai Haaroon alaihis-salaam paighambar ko ata kar diya
Aur apni kitaab mein Ismaaeel alaihis-salaam ka tazkira karo ke woh waade ke sachche aur hamaare bheje hue paighambar the
Aur woh apne ghar waalon ko namaaz aur zakaat ka hukm dete the, aur apne Parwardigar ke nazdeek pasandeeda the
Aur Kitaab-e-Khuda mein Idrees alaihis-salaam ka bhi tazkira karo ke woh bahut zyaada sachche paighambar the
Aur hum ne un ko buland jagah tak pahuncha diya hai

Yeh sab woh anbiya hain jin par Allah ne ne'mat naazil ki hai, zurriyat-e-Aadam mein se, aur un ki nasl mein se jin ko hum ne Nooh alaihis-salaam ke saath kashti mein uthaaya hai, aur Ibraheem alaihis-salaam o Israaeel alaihis-salaam ki zurriyat mein se, aur un mein se jin ko hum ne hidaayat di hai aur inhein muntakhab banaaya hai, ke jab un ke saamne Rehmaan ki aayatein padhi jaati hain to rote hue sajde mein gir padte hain
Phir un ke baad un ki jagah par woh log aaye jinhon ne namaaz ko barbaad kar diya aur khwaahishaat ka ittibaa' kar liya, pas yeh anqareeb apni gumraahi se ja milenge
Ilaawa un ke jinhon ne tauba kar li, imaan le aaye aur amal-e-saaleh kiya, ke woh Jannat mein daakhil honge aur un par kisi tarah ka zulm nahin kiya jaaega
Hamesha rehne waali Jannat jis ka Rehmaan ne apne bandon se ghaibi waada kiya hai, aur yaqeenan us ka waada saamne aane waala hai
Us Jannat mein salaam ke ilaawa koi laghw aawaaz sunne mein na aaegi, aur inhein subah o shaam rizq milta rahega
Yahi woh Jannat hai jis ka waaris hum apne bandon mein muttaqi afraad ko qaraar dete hain

Aur aye Paighambar! Hum farishte aap ke Parwardigar ke hukm ke baghair naazil nahin hote hain. Hamaare saamne ya pas-e-pusht ya us ke darmiyaan jo kuch hai sab us ke ikhtiyaar mein hai, aur aap ka Parwardigar bhoolne waala nahin hai
Woh aasmaan o zameen aur jo kuch un ke darmiyaan hai sab ka maalik hai, lihaaza us ki ibaadat karo aur us ibaadat ki raah mein sabr karo. Kya tumhaare ilm mein us ka koi hum-naam hai
Aur insaan yeh kehta hai ke kya jab hum mar jaayenge to dobaara zinda kar ke nikaale jaayenge
Kya yeh is baat ko yaad nahin karta hai ke pehle hum ne hi ise paida kiya hai jab yeh kuch nahin tha
Aur aap ke Rab ki qasam! Hum un sab ko aur un ke shayaateen ko ek jagah ikattha karenge, phir sab ko Jahannam ke atraaf ghutnon ke bal haazir karenge
Phir har giroh se aise afraad ko alag kar lenge jo Rehmaan ke haq mein zyaada naafarmaan the
Phir hum un logon ko bhi khoob jaante hain jo Jahannam mein jhonke jaane ke zyaada sazaawaar hain
Aur tum mein se koi aisa nahin hai jise Jahannam ke kinaare haazir na hona ho, ke yeh tumhaare Rab ka hatmi faisla hai
Us ke baad hum muttaqi afraad ko najaat de denge aur zaalimeen ko Jahannam mein chhod denge
Aur jab un ke saamne hamaari khuli hui aayatein pesh ki jaati hain to un mein ke kaafir saahibaan-e-imaan se kehte hain ke hum dono mein kis ki jagah behtar aur kis ki manzil zyaada haseen hai
Aur hum ne un se pehle kitni hi jamaa'aton ko halaak kar diya hai jo saaz o saamaan aur naam o namood mein un se kahin zyaada behtar the

Aap keh dijiye ke jo shakhs gumraahi mein pada rahega Khuda use aur dheel deta rahega, yahaan tak ke yeh waada-e-Ilaahi ko dekh lein, ya azaab ki ya qiyaamat ki shakl mein. Phir inhein maaloom ho jaaega ke jagah ke etibaar se badtareen aur madadgaaron ke etibaar se kamzor-tareen kaun hai
Aur Allah hidaayat-yaafta afraad ki hidaayat mein izaafa kar deta hai, aur baaqi rehne waali nekiyaan aap ke Parwardigar ke nazdeek sawaab aur baazgasht ke etibaar se behtareen aur buland-tareen hain
Kya tum ne us shakhs ko bhi dekha hai jis ne hamaari aayaat ka inkaar kiya aur yeh kehne laga ke humein qiyaamat mein bhi maal aur aulaad se nawaaza jaaega
Yeh ghaib se baakhabar ho gaya hai ya is ne Rehmaan se koi mu'aahida kar liya hai
Hargiz aisa nahin hai, hum is ki baaton ko darj kar rahe hain aur is ke azaab mein aur bhi izaafa kar denge
Aur is ke maal o aulaad ke hum hi maalik honge, aur yeh to hamaari baargaah mein akela haazir hoga
Aur un logon ne Khuda ko chhod kar doosre khuda ikhtiyaar kar liye hain taake woh un ke liye baais-e-izzat banein
Hargiz nahin, anqareeb yeh ma'bood khud hi un ki ibaadat se inkaar kar denge aur un ke mukhaalif ho jaayenge
Kya tum ne nahin dekha ke hum ne shayaateen ko kaafiron par musallat kar diya hai aur woh un ko behkaate rehte hain
Aap un ke baare mein azaab ki jaldi na karein, hum un ke din khud hi shumaar kar rahe hain
Qiyaamat ke din hum saahibaan-e-taqwa ko Rehmaan ki baargaah mein mehmaanon ki tarah jama karenge
Aur mujrimeen ko Jahannam ki taraf pyaase jaanwaron ki tarah dhakel denge
Us waqt koi shafaa'at ka saahib-e-ikhtiyaar na hoga, magar woh jis ne Rehmaan ki baargaah mein shafaa'at ka ahd le liya hai
Aur yeh log kehte hain ke Rehmaan ne kisi ko apna farzand bana liya hai
Yaqeenan tum logon ne badi sakht baat kahi hai
Qareeb hai ke is se aasmaan phat pade aur zameen shigaafta ho jaaye aur pahaad tukde tukde ho kar gir padein
Ke un logon ne Rehmaan ke liye beta qaraar de diya hai
Jab ke yeh Rehmaan ke shaayaan-e-shaan nahin hai ke woh kisi ko apna beta banaaye
Zameen o aasmaan mein koi aisa nahin hai jo us ki baargaah mein banda ban kar haazir hone waala na ho
Khuda ne sab ka ihsa kar liya hai aur sab ko baa-qaa'ida shumaar kar liya hai
Aur sab hi kal roz-e-qiyaamat us ki baargaah mein haazir hone waale hain
Beshak jo log imaan laaye aur unhon ne nek aamaal kiye anqareeb Rehmaan logon ke dilon mein un ki mohabbat paida kar dega
Bas hum ne is Quran ko tumhaari zabaan mein is liye aasaan kar diya hai ke tum muttaqeen ko bashaarat de sako aur jhagdaalu qaum ko azaab-e-Ilaahi se dara sako
Aur hum ne un se pehle kitni hi naslon ko barbaad kar diya hai. Kya tum un mein se kisi ko dekh rahe ho ya kisi ki aahat bhi sun rahe ho
